purpose: Choose one value from a predefined list presented in an accessible trigger and popover.

notes: Use VeliProvider so the trigger, popover, options, tooltip labels, and typography follow the active language and direction.

useWhen: Users must choose one value from a known set of options.
Options benefit from descriptions, leading or trailing content, or grouped sections.

avoidWhen.situation: Users need to type to filter a long option list or enter a custom value.
A small set of choices should remain visible for comparison.
A chosen value must stay visible and submit with the form, but the user must not change it.
avoidWhen.guidance: Select has no read-only state. Show the option label in a read-only Input with no name, and submit the option id with a hidden input (or equivalent form state). Do not put the label in a named Input value, and do not use a disabled Select.

supportedInteractions: Open and close the option popover
Keyboard navigation and typeahead through React Aria
approvedPatterns: Compose Select with SelectItem and optional SelectSection.
Provide textValue or aria-label for complex or icon-only option content.
Use description text normally and errorMessage when invalid.
Choose size and optional labelSupplementary, infoTooltip, and infoTooltipAriaLabel for the field header.
For a locked selected value, pair a nameless read-only Input (label text) with a hidden input that posts the option id.
limitations: This component is not an editable or filterable input.
Direct style and child layout overrides are not supported.
className is intended for outer layout.
accessibility: Uses React Aria Select, Button, Popover, ListBox, and Label semantics.
Selected options expose a visual check indicator.
Complex options require reliable accessible text for typeahead, selected value text, and screen readers.
responsive: The popover tracks the trigger width and the option list scrolls when its maximum height is reached.
rtl: The trigger, popover, option text, and section labels follow the active language and direction.
